description: JARS.LT provides programmatic access to the Lithuanian Company Registry (Registrų centras) data through a modern REST API. Our service allows developers and businesses to integrate official Lithuanian company information into their applications quickly and reliably. In addition to searching and detailing data on individual companies, the application provides tools for macro-analysis of the Lithuanian economy as a whole.
